caption:
Koko teaches on her feet all day, bending down to little desks again and again. By the end of class, her lower back feels heavy.

Bending from the back alone means it does most of the work. Using your knees and hips as well helps share the load. Clinical Pilates can help build hip and trunk strength so bending feels easier.

Hybi's 1-minute routine: bridges, hold 3 seconds, 10 reps, once a day. Stop if pain gets worse or your leg tingles.

Pain spreading down a leg or lasting more than two weeks is worth an assessment. Chat to our team at Hybrid Physio. Book online via the link in bio 🍎
